title: HGanttChartComponent
description: A horizontal Gantt chart for task timelines and refresh timings

sourceConnectorName.title: Input connector
sourceConnectorName.description: Optional data connector feeding this component

taskColumn.title: Task column
taskColumn.description: Column used as the row label

startColumn.title: Start column
startColumn.description: Numeric start time (ms). Leave empty with duration column only for sequential waterfall (name + time in ms).

endColumn.title: End column
endColumn.description: Numeric end time; leave empty when using duration column

durationColumn.title: Duration / time (ms) column
durationColumn.description: Duration in ms. With start: end = start + duration. Without start: sequential waterfall bars (each phase after the previous).

colorKeyColumn.title: Color key column (optional)
colorKeyColumn.description: Stable theme color key; defaults to task label

labelColumnWidth.title: Label column width (px)
labelColumnWidth.description: Width reserved for task names on the left (0 = auto ~28%)

rowHeight.title: Row height (px)
rowHeight.description: Preferred row pitch; rows scale down if needed to fit

rotation.title: Rotation (degrees)
rotation.description: Rotation angle in degrees around the component center

transparency.title: Transparency (0-100)
transparency.description: Opacity as a percentage: 0 = invisible, 100 = fully opaque

clipSize.title: Clip size
clipSize.description: When width and height are set (>0), drawing is clipped to the component geometry
